notes: Fixes since 1.1.89: guest segments forward nothing before the portal, never reach the panel or SSH, and get HTTPS after signing in; Kerio import carries group membership and names what it skipped; multi-WAN owns the default route, fails over and back (DHCP primary found in its own table, probes by source address); a PPPoE uplink is named by its PPP device (ppp-<port>) so clients behind it get NAT, and a backup PPPoE line no longer takes the default route or DNS; static interfaces keep their IPv6 addresses; a router left running after OSPF/BGP were removed is stopped; 52 missing translations added and guarded by a test.
